assessment_methods.method: Final assessment (oral exam and final paper)

assessment_rules: The material submitted by the student for the final exam will be evaluated by a preparatory committee. The preparatory committee will formulate an opinion/assessment and forward it to the Graduate Committee, which will make the final judgment. The final exam must be written and discussed in English.
